CheckTitle: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for the AWS account root user.
Risk: The root user has unrestricted access to every resource in the account. Without MFA, a leaked or guessed root password gives an attacker full, unrecoverable control of the account.

Recommendation.Text: Enable a virtual or hardware MFA device for the root user and store recovery material securely.
